question_stem:
The circuit of an inverting amplifier incorporating an ideal operational amplifier (op-amp) is shown
in Fig. 8.1.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain why point P is known as a virtual earth.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Derive an expression, in terms of the resistances $R_{1}$ and $R_{2}$, for the gain of the amplifier
circuit.
Explain your working.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A relay and the output terminals of the amplifier circuit are shown in Fig. 8.2.
On Fig. 8.2, show how the relay may be connected to the amplifier output so that the relay
operates only when $V_{\mathrm{OUT}}$ is positive.
